stemMarkdown: If 10 men can build a wall in 15 days, how many days will 15 men take to build the same wall, working at the same rate? (Round to 4 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: The wall needs $10 \times 15 = 150$ man-days of effort regardless of who does it. With 15 men that is $\dfrac{150}{15} = 10.0$ days.
